result.informal_description: The type representing the Selberg sieve in number theory.

name: DirichletCharacter
LFunction_isBigO_horizontal
result.signature: {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0 ∨ χ ≠ 1) : (fun x : ℝ ↦ LFunction χ (1 + x + I * y)) =O[𝓝[>] 0] fun _ ↦ (1 : ℂ)
result.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) [inst : NeZero N] {y : ℝ},
  y ≠ 0 ∨ χ ≠ 1 →
    (fun x => DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ (1 + ↑x + Complex.I * ↑y)) =O[nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)] fun x => 1
result.value:
:= by
  refine IsBigO.mono ?_ nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  simp_rw [add_comm (1 : ℂ), add_assoc]
  have := (χ.differentiableAt_LFunction _ <| one_add_I_mul_ne_one_or χ hy).continuousAt
  rw [← zero_add (1 + _)] at this
  exact this.comp (f := fun x : ℝ ↦ x + (1 + I * y)) (x := 0) (by fun_prop) |>.tendsto.isBigO_one ℂ
result.informal_name: Dirichlet L-function is $ O(1) $ horizontally near $ s = 1 $
result.informal_description: For a Dirichlet character $ \chi $ modulo $ N $ and real number $ y $, if $ y \neq 0 $ or $ \chi $ is nontrivial, then the Dirichlet L-function $ L(\chi, s) $ evaluated at $ s = 1 + x + iy $ satisfies $ L(\chi, 1 + x + iy) = O(1) $ as $ x \to 0^+ $.

name: DirichletCharacter
LFunction_ne_zero_of_one_le_re
result.signature: ⦃s : ℂ⦄ (hχs : χ ≠ 1 ∨ s ≠ 1) (hs : 1 ≤ s.re) : LFunction χ s ≠ 0
result.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) [inst : NeZero N] ⦃s : ℂ⦄,
  χ ≠ 1 ∨ s ≠ 1 → 1 ≤ s.re → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s ≠ 0
result.value:
:=
  hs.eq_or_lt.casesOn (fun hs ↦ LFunction_ne_zero_of_re_eq_one χ hs.symm hχs) fun hs ↦
    LFunction_eq_LSeries χ hs ▸ LSeries_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re χ hs
result.informal_name: Non-vanishing of Dirichlet L-functions on Re(s) ≥ 1 Except Trivial Character at s = 1
result.informal_description: For a Dirichlet character $\chi$ modulo $N$ and a complex number $s$ with $\operatorname{Re}(s) \geq 1$, if $\chi$ is not the trivial character or $s \neq 1$, then the Dirichlet $L$-function $L(s, \chi)$ is non-zero.

name: DirichletCharacter
LSeries_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re
result.signature: {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : L (↗χ) s ≠ 0
result.type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) {s : ℂ}, 1 < s.re → LSeries (fun n => χ ↑n) s ≠ 0
result.value: := fun h ↦ by simpa [h] using LSeries.mul_mu_eq_one χ hs
result.informal_name: Non-vanishing of Dirichlet L-series for Re(s) > 1
result.informal_description: For any Dirichlet character $\chi$ modulo $N$ and any complex number $s$ with $\operatorname{Re}(s) > 1$, the Dirichlet $L$-series $L(\chi, s)$ is non-zero.

name: DirichletCharacter
LFunction
result.type: {N : ℕ} → [NeZero N] → DirichletCharacter ℂ N → ℂ → ℂ
result.informal_description: For a Dirichlet character $\chi$ modulo $N$ and a complex number $s$, the Dirichlet L-function is defined as $N^{-s}$ multiplied by the sum over all $j \in \mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$ of $\chi(j)$ times the Hurwitz zeta function $\zeta(j/N, s)$, where $j/N$ is interpreted as an element of the additive circle $\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z}$.
